A 4 carat diamond ring is a significant purchase - the centre stone, the setting and how it sits on the hand all matter.

4 carat diamond ring price

As a broad range, 4 carat diamond rings cost from $18,000 to $200,000 depending on shape and quality, based on prices we checked when writing this guide.

[ninja_tables id="44100"]

4 carat diamond ring size

A typical 4 carat round diamond is about 10.2mm across. Fancy shapes vary.

Choosing a setting for a 4 carat diamond

At this weight the band needs to support the stone. A 2.5mm solitaire band is a practical starting point.
